data.name: Attempt to Survive
data.detailed_description:
A nuclear war has destroyed everything you ever knew. Cities lie in ruins, covered in ash, and all around you is nothing but silence and emptiness. You are one of the few who managed to survive. Or perhaps the last one.

As you wander through the devastated streets, you encounter ghosts of the past. Memories of life before the war keep coming back, forcing you to relive both the happy and the painful moments. Every neighborhood, every abandoned house holds echoes of a world that is no more.

Attempt to Survive is an interactive drama where the focus isn’t on speed and action, but on atmosphere, emotions, and immersion. Meticulously crafted locations, a melancholic soundtrack, and a profound sense of loneliness create a unique experience.

Key Features

  • A rich post-apocalyptic atmosphere

  • A deep narrative told through exploration and memories

  • Detailed, atmospheric locations

  • An emotional soundtrack that enhances immersion

  • A short but memorable story

Attempt to Survive is a game for those who appreciate quiet, atmospheric stories and want to briefly immerse themselves in a world where hope has faded and memories are all that remain.

What remains of a person when the world around them has collapsed?
